segments.text: The Lamb of God
Our dear Redeeming One is Christ
For our sins He paid the highest price
To redeem and to recover us
Who were lost and fallen far from God
At the last He had no punishment
He was seen, He did the mistake
How can we let him obediently understand that he made up the cross?
I want to follow him,
rest from all my wandering,
and all my endeavoring.
Even though I know not where or how
I know He cares
I know He'll gather where I go
He'll lead me well
I know His voice is now my choice
To follow where no man would be
When he came, no man he followed in the way to remain
Who knew him and his ways that were taught
He took the narrow gate, the touch of strength in ways to life he trained
Sacrificed, no man denied Him
Gave His life, no man forsook Him
How can we, for His still heart in me
When to us He gave all selflessly
I want to follow Him
Fresh from all the laundry
And all my endeavoring
Even though I know not where or how
I know He cares
I know He'll never fail
I know He'll lead me well
I know His voice, there's no more choice
I'm aware the Lamb would be
Lord, we pray, preserve us faithful in the way
All our days, never to fall away
By your grace, we ask for two in you
Taking up the cross to follow you
God, we pray, be our reserve in thee
That shall do
For you inspire me
In our hearts
For that the highway
Sees unto thy
A single heart in me
Now we will follow him
Till his power
Has prevailed
All we are, we're offering
In Jerusalem, we seek the Lamb
From heaven to earth
God has an angel now
Our God is the above
Eternally, over and free
This is where the Lamb will be
